proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Hyperboloidal integration and the scaling-ray initial term leave the available bootstrap domains

Recorded check: The characteristic estimate in Lemma4.13 is false as printed and its boundary and mass hypotheses need revision

Recorded check: Separate fixed-mass smallness from uniform positivity of the separating-surface flux

Recorded check: Use consistent exterior slices and truncated hyperboloids

Recorded check: Missing factor two in the null-to-hyperboloidal coefficient identity

Recorded check: Correct the semi-hyperboloidal drift and associated equation signs

Recorded check: Restore the variable-mass derivative in the oscillator energy and the original cutoff argument

Recorded check: State the uniform time-flux estimate actually needed in the exterior bootstrap

Recorded check: The zero-mode source cutoff does not have the stated exterior support
